Toddler meals

Sweet potato curd dumplings

Édesburgonyás túrógombóc

8 months+ Adjusted 55 min 4 portions

Serve warm and soft, in small pieces. They should yield to a finger, not crunch.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 250 g Sweet potato (Baked until very soft, then mashed)
  • 150 g Cottage cheese (Pasteurized; drain off extra whey)
  • 1 Egg (Mixed through and cooked until set)
  • 50 g Plain wheat flour (Just enough to hold a soft shape)

Allergens

milkegggluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C and bake the sweet potato until it collapses.
  2. Mash the flesh with the cottage cheese and egg.
  3. Work in the flour until the mix holds a soft mound.
  4. Set small mounds on a lined tray and do not coat them.
  5. Bake until the egg is set and the centres stay soft, about 18 minutes.
  6. Cool slightly and serve in tender pieces.

Adjusted

Crisp crumbs and a sugary coating are the wrong finish. The egg must be fully set and the dumplings must stay soft.

Use pasteurized cottage cheese, baked sweet potato, a little flour, and egg, and boil or bake only until set. Do not roll them in crumbs and do not sweeten them.
